loading.title: Synchronizing the cycle horizon
loading.body: Reading the live protocol clock before the countdown appears.

openingSoon.title: {cycle} opens soon
openingSoon.body: The next cycle is preparing to open. When this countdown reaches zero, Gestures become available.

waitingFirstGesture.title: {cycle} is waiting for its first Gesture
waitingFirstGesture.body: The first Gesture ignites the Cycle Finalization Time and starts shaping the next Signature.

approach.title: {cycle} finalizes in
approach.body: The cycle is live. Each Gesture shapes the Signature and can extend the finalization clock.

finalHour.title: {cycle} is entering the final hour
finalHour.body: Every new Gesture can extend the horizon and leave one more trace on the evolving Signature.

nearHorizon.title: {cycle} is near the horizon
nearHorizon.body: The Cycle Finalization Time is almost here. The next moments decide the final shape.

ready.title: {cycle} is ready to finalize
ready.body: The horizon has closed. The protocol is ready to transform the cycle into a final Signature.

unavailable.title: Live cycle clock unavailable
unavailable.body: The landing page could not reach the protocol clock. Open the app for the latest cycle state.

live.title: {cycle} finalizes in
live.body: This is the same live Cycle Finalization Time shown in the app. Each Gesture shapes the Signature and can extend the horizon.

status.waitingFirstGesture: Open and waiting for the first Gesture
